card.name: Start of S in medical terms
card.fires_on: A capital or lowercase S (or similar letter) that begins the second part of a split medical term, like Ankylosing S|pondylitis, spleen after a number table, or bovine s|pongiform. Also some section number digits.

modes.label: S in Ankylosing Spondylitis
modes.description: The S that starts Spondylitis after Ankylosing in indication or trial headings.

modes.label: Spleen in organ dose tables
modes.description: The S of Spleen following an organ name and numbers in dosimetry tables.

modes.label: Other split S terms
modes.description: An s or S starting a rare term such as spongiform or Scheuermann's.

card.writes: It seems to push rare word continuations after an initial letter and to discourage the "enter" family.
card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a hard medical word, such as the S in Spondylitis, when the word is split up.
